settings.title: Settings
settings.status_starting: Container running — server not answering yet
settings.connect_desc: In Wesnoth: Multiplayer → Connect to Server → address {address} (the client version must match the accepted versions below). Players who cannot reach {address} need a port forward or a DNS name for it.
settings.game_port_helper: Published on the node and opened on the node firewall. Default 15000, the Wesnoth standard port.
settings.admin_password_placeholder: leave empty to keep the current password
settings.admin_password_helper: Lets a player become server admin from the client (/query admin <password>). The console below works without it.
settings.admin_not_set: No administrator password: admin commands only via the console below.
settings.motd_helper: Shown to every player entering the lobby.
settings.connections_allowed_helper: 0 = unlimited. Several players behind the same router share one address.
settings.versions_accepted_helper: Comma separated patterns with * and ? wildcards. Empty: every release of the server's own stable series (recommended).
settings.save_replays_helper: Replays are written to the wesnoth-data volume (replays/) and included in the backup.
settings.disallow_names_helper: One pattern per line (* and ? wildcards). Empty: wesnothd defaults (*admin*, *server*, ai, computer, human, network, player, …).
settings.log_level_helper: Info shows joins, leaves and console answers in the log; debug is very verbose. The console needs at least info.
settings.command_helper: wesnothd admin commands: status, games, metrics, msg <text>, kick <nick> [reason], ban <mask> <time> [reason] (times: short, day, week, month or e.g. 2D12h), unban <mask>, bans, motd <text>, help.
settings.port_in_use: Port already in use on this node
settings.invalid_name_pattern: Nickname patterns must not contain spaces, commas or quotes
